newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse stops price surge of two shares.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse stops price surge of two shares.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) halted on Thursday the price rise of Liberty Flour Mills Inc and Fil-Hispano Ceramics B after both issues jumped by 50 percent.

The PSE surveillance department said Liberty's rise was stopped when it reached 33 pesos in late trade from 22 pesos. Earlier, the price jump of rarely traded construction issue Fil-Hispano was halted at 30 pesos from 20 pesos.
The bourse automatically stops the rise of any issue which jumps by 50 percent or close to it within a single session. The shares can only traded at the price at which it was frozen or below it.
